title: feature-flag-ext
blurb: Add a last-known-good flag client that refreshes snapshots without turning a control-plane outage into an application outage.
brief:
The application currently has a working remote flag source but no runtime client. Add `flag_runtime/` with an environment-scoped, TTL-based snapshot client. A refresh failure may use an existing last-known-good snapshot, but a cold start must surface the outage.

Use the injected clock; do not start background threads or sleep. Only a fully fetched snapshot may replace the cached value, and different environments must never share snapshots.

**Your job:** implement bounded-refresh flag evaluation with explicit stale fallback while preserving source errors on cold start.
